lines.text: A tornado flew around my room before you came / Excuse the mess it made, it usually doesn't rain / In Southern California, where's the thunder sayin'? / And to see you kissing someone who isn't me

And maybe I would go to all of the places that I'd rather go alone / But I won't forget the woman that you loved / She's not you but unlike you, she's got soul / And she will sleep alone tonight, the one who's weeping / The one who's stuck inside a box where other people are successful
A tornado flew around my room before you came / Excuse the mess it made, it usually doesn't rain in / Southern California, much like Arizona / My eyes don't shed tears, but the boy inside them does
I know you need to want it, I know you need it / Baby, if you don't want me, don't want me / Don't pretend you do, baby / I've been thinking 'bout you ever since you were sixteen

It's like you walked into my life on a Saturday / Now it's Thursday, not just shelter from rain also from shame / I'ma swim through a hundred seas / I got a bottle with a message inside, and it's still unopened, still unopened

Or maybe our time is right, maybe / If I saw you tonight, would you even remember my face? / I was with your friend, Jesse Williams, we were trippin' / Now you know, girl, you know, since we was seventeen / How could you be so fine and not be mine?

When I heard your voice, I reloaded the page right away / You look the same / Most people don't work round the clock, whose do you know? / Tell me what they do for you / Baby, without you, without you I'm a slave / Without you I'm an empty region full of space

Draw the map that'll lead me to you / The stars in the sky seem to give a clue / The constellations seem to tell me that / Maybe I'll take another step, you're always at the top of my stairs in the dark / Singin' this song
